description: This file defines an abstract class 'PurgeStrategy' for implementing different data purge strategies within the OrangeHRM system's maintenance plugin. It includes methods for managing purge parameters, accessing related services, and retrieving database records based on employee data.

classes.name: PurgeStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that defines a blueprint for various purge strategies to clean or remove employee-related records in the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purge strategy with the entity class name and an InfoArray object containing parameters and field mappings.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of PurgeService used for data purging operations.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of match criteria based on employee number and optional join parameters for querying.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves database records matching the provided criteria from a specific table using the purge DAO.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters array associated with the purge strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the entity class name that the purge strategy operates on.

methods.name: getEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the field mapping array used for matching records.
